text:
## MANDATORY MODULES  
- **Module 1:** AML & Sanctions Compliance
- **Module 2:** Know Your Customer (KYC)
- **Module 3:** GDPR & Data Protection
- **Module 4:** Fraud Prevention
- **Module 5:** Reporting Obligations
- **Module 6:** Consequences of Non-Compliance  
**Completion Required:** Yes, all staff
**Frequency:** Annual (or immediately upon change in regulations)
**Assessment:** Quiz at end of each module (pass = 80%+)
**Certificate:** Issued upon completion

context: Assessment: Quiz at end of each module (pass = 80%+)

raw_entities.description: Mandatory annual training module on fraud prevention and detection for all staff. Requires passing end-of-module quiz at 80% threshold with certificate issued upon completion.
context: Assessment: Quiz at end of each module (pass = 80%+)

context: Assessment: Quiz at end of each module (pass = 80%+)

raw_entities.description: Mandatory annual training module explaining the consequences and penalties for non-compliance with regulatory and internal requirements. Requires 80% pass threshold on end-of-module quiz with certificate issued upon completion.
context: Assessment: Quiz at end of each module (pass = 80%+)

raw_entities.description: All staff are required to complete the six mandatory compliance training modules annually or immediately upon regulatory change. Completion is tracked and certificated.
